question: Should official macOS publishing now fail closed when an authorized release environment lacks `NOTARYTOOL_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE`, rather than preserving the prior signing-only release path?
rationale: This is an intentional release-security and operator-compatibility policy choice: source review can confirm the mechanics, but cannot decide whether all current release environments are ready for the required Keychain profile.

options.title: Require notarization for all official macOS releases
options.body: Confirm the approved profile rollout and keep the new fail-closed packaging contract, with real notarization proof attached before merge.

options.title: Stage the credential requirement
options.body: Preserve the signing-only path temporarily while introducing an explicitly documented release transition until all authorized release hosts have the profile.

recommendation.title: Require notarization for all official macOS releases
recommendation.body: Confirm the approved profile rollout and keep the new fail-closed packaging contract, with real notarization proof attached before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: A release-path owner is needed because the decision concerns credentials and official publishing policy rather than an ordinary code defect.
